reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Unchecked AI risks outweighing benefits
themes.definition: AI framed as an unprecedented technology challenging human supremacy whose unregulated advance may carry risks greater than its benefits.
themes.inclusion: Passages claiming AI challenges the supremacy of the human mind or that risks of unchecked AI could outweigh benefits.
themes.exclusion: Passages on AI's harms to children specifically or military uses.
themes.boundary_cases: Benefits acknowledged in passing before a risk-dominant conclusion still fit here rather than duality.

examples.quote: we have created a technology that openly challenges the supremacy of the human mind as the pinnacle of our evolutionary development
the risks of an unchecked and unregulated advance in artificial intelligence could greatly outweigh its potential benefits

themes.label: AI as present-day strategic infrastructure
themes.definition: AI framed as current infrastructure and a factor shaping the future international order alongside energy grids, data centres and connectivity.
themes.inclusion: Passages describing AI as present infrastructure or as a site where geopolitical order is shaped.
themes.exclusion: Passages naming AI only as a future challenge in a list.
themes.boundary_cases: Data centres or grids mentioned without AI do not qualify.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence is not longer a subject of the future. It is infrastructure for today, for the present.

themes.label: Digital technology harms to children
themes.definition: AI introduced together with adverse effects of digital technology on children and teenagers.
themes.inclusion: Passages flagging AI or digital technology harms to children and adolescents.
themes.exclusion: Youth education and skills framing (use AI_YOUTH_EDUCATION).
themes.boundary_cases: A transition sentence announcing AI and child harms as topics counts as a brief mention of this theme.

examples.quote: the advent of artificial intelligence (AI) and the adverse effects of digital technology, especially on our children and our teenagers

themes.label: AI listed among complex global issues
themes.definition: AI named in a list of complex challenges (climate, geopolitics) without elaboration.
themes.inclusion: Passages naming AI as one item among issues populists or others avoid or that the world faces.
themes.exclusion: Passages developing AI risks, benefits or policy.
themes.boundary_cases: Labelling AI a 'disruptive technology' in a list is still a list mention.

examples.quote: be it on climate change, disruptive technologies like artificial intelligence, mutual political and economic dependencies

value.rationale: European passages that mostly introduce AI at the close of a speech; Greece 2026 gives a risk-dominant, human-supremacy framing, North Macedonia treats AI as present infrastructure, Greece 2024 links AI to harms to children, and Austria merely lists AI.
